anomaly_label: Overshooting pressure-control response of vacuum throttle valve (TV1)

evidence.observation: T701 reads 431.291 °C versus T702 96.834 °C and vessel T703 91.228 °C, a large heater-temperature discrepancy requiring verification.
Discrepancy persists: T701 434.359 °C, T702 107.900 °C, and T703 96.765 °C; readings alone cannot distinguish actual overheating from a sensor fault.
T711 jumps from 72.324 to 82.755 °C while T705 falls from 65.893 to 64.096 °C; distillate/reflux flows rise from 0.209/0.414 to 0.294/0.619.
T711 remains elevated at 82.375 °C; distillate/reflux flows are 0.238/0.516 and cooling-water flow remains present at 4.558.

args.missing_evidence: Expected heater temperatures, safety limits and commanded operating changes; independent H701 temperature and heater-power checks to distinguish overheating from measurement error; composition analysis and target specification. Pressure instruments are not installed, so pressure-related causes cannot be assessed directly.
